applicableAreas: Southern property boundary along Valley View Road
findings.comment: Proposed trees including Live Oak are positioned immediately adjacent (approximately 0 feet) to the overhead electric line along the southern boundary. Utility-compatible status is not documented in the plant schedule per ECM Appendix F, and Live Oak is not utility-compatible. Trees must be at least 15 feet from distribution conductors.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary along Valley View Road
findings.comment: Proposed large trees (Live Oak with 50-80 feet mature height and Cedar Elm with 40-60 feet mature height per ECM Appendix F) are positioned immediately adjacent (approximately 0 feet) to the overhead electric line along the southern boundary, violating the 25-foot minimum clearance requirement.

Two trees shown in the southern boundary row (marked with center-dot symbols on Landscape Plan) cannot be identified to species. The symbols do not match any species listed in the plant schedule on Sheet 35, and no plant legend legend connects landscape plan symbols to specific plant species.

Plant schedule does not differentiate large trees (40+ feet mature height per ECM Appendix F). Live Oak and Cedar Elm are both proposed large trees but are not identified as such, making it impossible to verify clearance compliance for large tree restrictions.

Landscape Plan shows trees and overhead electric line but does not clearly depict the spatial relationship between specific tree species and conductor locations. No dimensions or callouts indicate clearances from trees to the OHE line, preventing verification of compliance with clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary along Valley View Road
findings.comment: Proposed trees are positioned within prohibited clearance zones from overhead electric distribution conductors (0 feet from line, requiring minimum 15 feet for any tree and 25 feet for large trees). No documentation of written approval from Austin Energy is provided on the plans or in supporting materials.
